nodes.name: rpcResult
nodes.condition: !(status.Closed() || dexflow.ValueOrZero(closingAttribute.Get(ctx)) || submission.Identity != comm.Must(identityAttribute.Get(ctx))) and record == nil || record.HeadCommit == submission.Contribution.HeadCommit

nodes.name: rpcResult
nodes.condition: !(status.Closed() || dexflow.ValueOrZero(closingAttribute.Get(ctx)) || submission.Identity != comm.Must(identityAttribute.Get(ctx))) and !(record == nil || record.HeadCommit == submission.Contribution.HeadCommit)

nodes.name: deadEnd
nodes.condition: !(record.Status.Closed() || dexflow.ValueOrZero(closingAttribute.Get(ctx)) || record.HeadCommit != attempt.HeadCommit) and !(attempt.PullRequest != nil) and record.Status.HasPullRequest()

nodes.name: deadEnd
nodes.condition: !(dexflow.ValueOrZero(closingAttribute.Get(ctx))) and notification.Event == conversation.ConnectorChecksFailed and record.Status.Closed() || record.HeadCommit != notification.Commit

nodes.name: goTo
nodes.condition: err != nil || attempt.Checks.State == connectorlibrary.HeadChecksPending and attempt.Number < connectorCheckMaxReads

nodes.name: goTo
nodes.condition: err != nil || attempt.Checks.State == connectorlibrary.HeadChecksPending and !(attempt.Number < connectorCheckMaxReads)

nodes.name: goTo
nodes.condition: !(err != nil || attempt.Checks.State == connectorlibrary.HeadChecksPending) and attempt.Checks.State == connectorlibrary.HeadChecksFailed and err != nil

metadata.explanation: Ask the Session to admit the contribution before any effect, then record it and open its pull request beside the wait for its end.
Wait for the close of a deleting Project's contribution, then end it, cancelling a pull request still being opened.
Drop a connector notification whose delivery exhausted its retries; the record keeps the failure.
Find the pull request of the branch, or push the branch from the local Git host and open it as a draft, polling without a lock.
Request the head's release candidate of the connectors library and poll until its release holds its assets, without a lock.
Record only the current head's bounded CI result, and notify the Session of a failed head.
Record the draft pull request, or the failure of a refused or timed-out opening, and report a failure to the Session.
Record the head's release candidate, published or failed, and report it to the Session; a candidate of an older head is dropped.
Deliver the connector notification of a failed pull request to the Session through the Session Service, once per head commit.
Wait for a fixed business timer, then read the exact head's aggregate GitHub Actions result once.

fields.description: The contribution's branch, head commit and pull request
